description: Read a manager root's bound public key — the public machine-legible fact (CO 314): public_key, alg, kid, bound_at. A counterparty verifies this root's signatures against it. Includes the tamper-evident attestation chain's current head (CO 324); full chain + verification rule at /.well-known/key-attestation-chain. Omit manager_id to read your own. Never returns any challenge or secret. Returns: { public_key, alg, kid, bound_at } + the attestation chain head. Never a challenge or secret. Example: call federation_key_status with arguments {}.

manager_id.description: The root to read; defaults to the caller.

name: federation_key_status
